summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories like Hugging Face—which crossed 3 million public models in August 2026—and developer-facing inference platforms such as Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow that make it easy to run or serve open-weight models via API. Download distribution is highly concentrated: roughly half of Hugging Face models have under 200 downloads while the top 200 models account for nearly 50% of all downloads. These hubs and inference APIs are distinct from enterprise aggregators (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and managed MLOps platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI), focusing instead on open access, rapid prototyping, and cost-efficient serving of open models.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central hub for hosting, sharing, and discovering open-source AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus a serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints.
platforms.model_count: Over 3 million public models (3,011,630+ as of August 2026)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for hosting and limited inference; PRO at ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints billed per compute hour; Enterprise Hub custom pricing
features: Largest open model and dataset repository
Model/dataset cards and download statistics
Spaces for interactive demos
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open libraries
Community collaboration, versioning, and git-based repos
platforms.best_for: Researchers, developers, and organizations wanting the broadest open model selection, collaboration, and flexible hosting/inference options

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first tool for running open LLMs and multimodal models directly on your own machine with a simple CLI and API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; runs on local hardware (no usage fees); optional cloud/turbo tiers emerging
features: One-command local model download and run
Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
OpenAI-compatible local API endpoint
GGUF quantized model support for consumer hardware
Modelfile customization and easy model switching
Offline, privacy-preserving inference
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally for prototyping, offline use, or self-hosting

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and deploying open-source models via API, including image, video, audio, and language models packaged as reproducible containers.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models (Cog-packaged)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU usage); no subscription required
features: Run thousands of community models via simple API
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Supports image generation, video, audio, and LLMs
Automatic scaling and no infrastructure management
Fine-tuning support for select models
Webhooks and streaming outputs
platforms.best_for: Developers who want to quickly integrate or deploy diverse open models (especially generative media) without managing infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-source LLMs and multimodal models, plus dedicated GPU clusters for training.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mixtral, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (tiered by model size); per-hour pricing for dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters
features: Fast serverless inference with OpenAI-compatible API
Fine-tuning and custom model hosting
Dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters for training
Optimized inference stack for low latency and throughput
Broad catalog of open chat, code, image, and embedding models
Batch inference support
platforms.best_for: Startups and enterprises needing scalable, cost-effective inference and fine-tuning of open models with production-grade performance

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A speed-optimized inference platform for open-source and custom LLMs, vision, and audio models, targeting low-latency production workloads.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom model deployment
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; per-GPU-hour for dedicated deployments; volume discounts
features: Highly optimized, low-latency inference engine (FireAttention)
OpenAI-compatible API
Fine-tuning and LoRA adapter serving
Function calling and structured JSON output support
Multimodal and audio model support
On-demand and dedicated GPU deployments
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies prioritizing fast, production-grade inference and custom model serving at scale

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer-facing inference platform offering fast, affordable API access to a wide range of open-source LLMs and multimodal models, with strong coverage of Chinese and global open models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Llama, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Competitive pay-per-token pricing with free credits; some models offered free; dedicated instances available
features: Low-cost, high-speed inference API
OpenAI-compatible endpoints
Strong catalog of leading Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM)
Text, image, audio, and embedding model support
Fine-tuning and dedicated deployment options
Generous free tier for popular models
platforms.best_for: Developers seeking cost-effective inference and broad access to top Chinese and global open-weight models

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform using custom LPU hardware to serve open LLMs at exceptionally high token throughput.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of open models (Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek distillations)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with competitive rates; free developer tier with rate limits
features: Industry-leading inference speed via LPU architecture
OpenAI-compatible API
Very low time-to-first-token and high tokens/sec
Curated selection of popular open models
Simple developer onboarding
Batch and real-time inference
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-sensitive, real-time applications needing the fastest possible open-model inference

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers, enabling easy model comparison and failover.
platforms.model_count: 400+ models aggregated from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pass-through per-token pricing from underlying providers plus a small routing fee; pay-as-you-go credits
features: Single API for hundreds of models across providers
Automatic provider routing, fallback, and load balancing
Price and performance transparency per model
OpenAI-compatible interface
Access to both open-weight and proprietary models
Usage analytics and spend controls
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to many models through one integration
